name: SongPro 5
shortDescription: A UK-developed Windows worship-presentation application for song lyrics, Bible passages, media, PowerPoint, service planning and stage displays.
suitableContexts: Windows-based churches preparing Sunday-service media and worship slides
Teams that need multiple production and preparation PC installs
Churches needing song, Bible, PowerPoint, video and stage-display workflow in one desktop application

pricing.summary: SongPro publishes annual per-install bundles from £120 for one PC to £270 for six PCs, with a 30-day trial. Some Bible modules cost £15 per computer as one-off purchases. Confirm VAT, licence renewal and required Bible rights before buying.

startingPrice.qualifier: Budget licence for one PC install

dataHosting: SongPro is a desktop application. Its privacy policy says purchaser and licence information is held in an encrypted database, but it does not establish a full current hosting or retention schedule. Keep church member data out of presentation assets unless the church has a clear purpose and retention decision.
gdprInformation: The supplier publishes a privacy policy describing purchaser, licence and device information it collects. This is supplier documentation, not an assessment of a church's processing or copyright permissions.
coreFeatures: Media, song and Bible import options
integrations: CCLI SongSelect where an appropriate licence is held
Video and media formats supported by the local application
importExport: Test service-plan, song and media migration using the church's own library before changing systems
support: Supplier publishes contact and support routes
30-day full trial is available, with stated Bible-translation limitations during the trial

uk-purchasing.value: Creation Software Limited is an active UK company, number 03029045, and its product materials identify it as SongPro's operator.

pricing.value: Supplier publishes £120–£270 annual licence bundles for one to six PCs and £15 one-off prices for selected Bible modules.

current-product.value: Supplier publishes a 30-day SongPro 5 trial installer last modified in September 2025.

licensing.value: Supplier terms state that SongPro is annually licensed and that projecting compositions requires the church to hold an appropriate copyright licence where needed.

editorial.assessment: SongPro is a mature UK desktop choice for churches that want a Windows-based worship-presentation workflow rather than a cloud-first platform. Its per-install annual price is clear, and its trial makes local testing practical. A church must separately secure music and Bible permissions: software ownership does not grant copyright permissions.
bestFor: Churches needing two or more licensed preparation/display PCs
Teams wanting a full local-service workflow with song, Bible, PowerPoint and stage-screen support
strengths: Longstanding active UK software company with current downloadable trial
Clear copyright and licence boundary in supplier terms
limitations: Annual licence model and selected paid Bible modules
Not a church member database, online-giving platform or substitute for rights clearance

procurementVerdict.problem: Preparing and running a weekly church service across songs, Bible readings, PowerPoint, media and stage displays
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A mature UK Windows application with a published per-install licence model and broad local-service functions
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run a complete service on the actual display hardware and confirm all Bible, song and video rights before renewal
